question: In round 5, the first successful byte-identity check of the child-pair layout on the default scene (64 spp, seed 1, against out/r4_default.pfm) printed a setup line. What setup_ms did it show?
answer:
setup_ms = 245.7 ms.

How I know: the first byte-identity check of the child-pair layout on the default scene (512x512, 64 spp, seed 1) is my tool result at history message #163, which printed

  setup_ms=245.7 samples=16777216 width=512 height=512 spp=64 threads_used=4 triangles=69451 bvh_nodes=81521
  IDENTICAL_DEFAULT

(its PFM compared byte-identical to out/r4_default.pfm). The attempt just before it, #159, produced no setup line at all because it passed the wrong config path ("scene error: cannot open scene config: scenes/scene-default.json" — the scene JSONs sit at the top level of the workspace), so #163 is indeed the first successful one. For context, the two other scenes in that same batch printed setup_ms=201.2 (alt-view) and 192.1 (caustic-closeup), and that elevated setup time is expected: it includes compiling the shaders and building the BVH, and the machine was under heavy contention at the time (load average ~4-5, frame times inflated from the ~43 ms floor to 60-95 ms).

question: In round 5, the first successful byte-identity check of the child-pair layout on the default scene (64 spp, seed 1, against out/r4_default.pfm) printed a setup line. What setup_ms did it show?
answer:
setup_ms=245.7.

How I know: history message #163 is the first successful byte-identity check of the child-pair (PtBvhChild 32-byte block) layout on the default scene — command `./pathtracer/pathtracer --scene-config scene-default.json --spp 64 --seed 1 --out-pfm out/cp_default.pfm --out out/cp_default.ppm`, whose output line reads exactly "setup_ms=245.7 samples=16777216 width=512 height=512 spp=64 threads_used=4 triangles=69451 bvh_nodes=81521" followed by "IDENTICAL_DEFAULT" (cmp against out/r4_default.pfm passed). The two attempts just before it do not qualify: #159 failed on a wrong scene path (`scenes/scene-default.json` — the configs live at the top level) and printed no setup line at all. Note that child-pair candidate was later rejected as a statistical wash (n=41 paired rounds, mean base−cand = +0.104 ± 0.218 ms) and the tree was reverted to _b.
